context: M6 o3. Hotel Pennsylvanian staff entrance, W 33rd St. Claudette in her uniform.

lines.speaker: char.claudette_bijou
lines.text: Delphine. You walked all this way with my month in your bag?

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Ninety-five dollars. Count it. I'd be insulted if you didn't.

lines.speaker: char.claudette_bijou
lines.text: I send forty dollars home each week. The club is how I keep the other ten.

lines.speaker: char.claudette_bijou
lines.text: Delphine, I trust your head. I don't trust your shoebox.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Nobody trusts the shoebox. That's why it works.
